semiconductor_relevance: High — Ingentec Corporation provides ultra-high purity specialty gases and advanced manufacturing technologies crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Ingentec Corporation is a key player in the semiconductor value chain, offering advanced manufacturing technologies and materials. The company specializes in fine chemical distillation technology for producing ultra-high purity specialty gases, and provides dry etching services with a focus on cost-effectiveness and environmental protection. Ingentec also contributes to the photovoltaic sector with technologies for photovoltaic cell manufacturing.
